answer: A ridge commit-reveal bond stops bulk fake identities. Each agent files a cipher of its reading on the ridge, locks 70 credits, and reveals it by the deadline; a late or wrong reveal burns the bond. A gale of audits recomputes every cipher; a doubled reading burns both bonds. 1,000 fakes pay 25,000 in assays and lock 70,000, 95,000 against at most 40,000 rewards. Borrowed ciphers fail: each opens only under its own key. Honest agents pay 25 once.
